hotel_name: Dorado Beach, a Ritz Carlton Reserve

claims.text: Laurance S. Rockefeller opened the resort in the 1950s on a former plantation.

findings.quote: When developer Laurance S. Rockefeller opened his resort in the 1950s, he took care to preserve what made the former plantation, and Puerto Rico, special.

claims.text: In Rockefeller's original resort, buildings were no taller than palm trees.

findings.quote: Buildings were no taller than palm trees.
findings.note: Stated in the history of Rockefeller's resort

claims.text: Signature dishes at COA restaurant carry the flavor of Mi Brasa, a traditional Spanish wood-burning oven.

findings.quote: signature dishes carry the flavor of Mi Brasa, a traditional, Spanish wood-burning oven.

claims.text: A residential kitchen at La Cocina Gourmet hosts hands-on, chef-led cooking classes and five-course themed wine dinners.

findings.quote: A residential kitchen, tucked within the resort’s La Cocina Gourmet, hosts hands-on, chef-led cooking classes showcasing local, seasonal ingredients and five-course themed wine dinners.

claims.text: Spa Botánico treatments are performed amid gardens and shaded treetops.

findings.quote: where treatments are performed amid lush gardens and shaded treetops.
findings.note: Spa Botánico treatments amid gardens and shaded treetops

claims.text: Spa Botánico offers a Treehouse Massage amid the treetops.

findings.quote: Experience an unforgettable massage amidst the treetops, surrounded by the magical sounds of nature.
findings.note: Treehouse Massage listed under spa treatments, amid the treetops

claims.text: A 100-year-old Ficus tree stands at the entrance to Spa Botánico.

findings.quote: A 100-year-old Ficus tree welcomes you at the Spa Botanico entrance.

claims.text: The resort has two pools, both with direct access to the beach.

findings.quote: The resort’s two pools offer distinct experiences, both with direct access to Dorado’s golden sands.
findings.note: Two pools, both with direct beach access

claims.text: Every room is assigned an embajador, a personal butler.

findings.quote:
Every room is assigned an
embajador
, a personal butler charged with enhancing experiences.

claims.text: All rooms include indoor and outdoor rainforest showers along with soaking tubs; some also have private plunge pools.

findings.quote: all rooms include indoor and outdoor rainforest showers along with soaking tubs; some also feature private plunge pools.

claims.text: La Cava at COA restaurant is a wine cellar with 690 labels and 3,200 bottles, which the resort describes as the largest wine cellar in Puerto Rico.

findings.quote: With its 690 labels and 3,200 bottles, the CAVA wine cellar offers one of the largest wine lists in the Caribbean and the largest wine cellar in Puerto Rico.
findings.note: Resort page states all figures and superlative

claims.text: In 2012 Ritz-Carlton transformed the resort into its first Reserve property in the Americas.

findings.quote: In 2012, Ritz-Carlton transformed it into its first Reserve property in the Americas.

claims.text: The Rockefeller Nature Trail is an 11-mile trail that runs past the two golf courses, along sandy beaches and through tree-shaded forests.

findings.quote: this 11-mile trail takes guests past the two golf courses, along the soft-sand beaches and through tree-shaded forests

claims.text: The Treehouse Dinner is a private dining experience for two people, usually recommended for couples.

findings.quote: Our Treehouse Dining experience is a very intimate experience and usually recommended for couples, as the space is limited and only fits two people.
findings.note: Private for two, recommended for couples

claims.text: Spa Botánico is a five-acre sanctuary that pairs local Puerto Rican ingredients with indigenous soothing traditions.

findings.quote: The five-acre sanctuary pairs local Puerto Rican ingredients with indigenous soothing traditions

claims.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport is 26.3 miles from the property.

findings.quote: The closest airport near Dorado Beach, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve is Luis Munoz Marin International Airport (SJU).
SJU is located approximately 26.3 Miles from the hotel.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited dining variety compared to larger resort destinations.
